title: A small insurance job
description:
A small insurance job on a recently decorated property,  where oil had been splashed over 2 walls and the ceiling. 
Prepped, stain blocked and re-coated a couple times. All sorted.

title: Exterior Painting Job

Completed and dry just before the rain came
